svg.title: Basis changes, gauge rotations, and physical deformation
svg.desc: Four lattice panels compare an original two-dimensional cell, an integer basis relabeling that preserves the lattice sites, a rigid Cartesian gauge rotation that preserves the metric, and a physical deformation that changes the metric and lattice sites.
